h1: Architectural design of houses and facades in Bratislava

blocks.text: Architectural design of houses and facades in Bratislava

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) works with private houses and residential and commercial properties: architectural design, renovation, interior architecture, and 3D visualization.
Concepts and designs for private houses and residential and commercial buildings. We work out the massing and spatial solutions, facades, proportions, materials, and exterior appearance.
Facade design for new and existing buildings: finishing materials, color, architectural elements, and lighting brought together in a single contemporary look.

blocks.text: Renovation and adaptive reuse of buildings

parts.html: We design renovations of existing buildings: changing their appearance and adapting the space to new uses.
For historic and architecturally significant buildings, design solutions are developed with the specific features of the property and the applicable preservation requirements in mind.
We design the grounds in the same style as the house: pathways, seating areas, outdoor lighting, planting, and other landscape elements.
Where needed, we build energy-efficient solutions and the efficient use of materials into the design — this reduces the building’s operating costs.
We design interior spaces with the building’s architecture, layout, functional zoning, and usage scenarios in mind.
Architecture and interior are treated as a single system, which makes it possible to create a functional and visually cohesive space.
We create detailed photorealistic 3D visualizations of facades, exteriors, interiors, and the surrounding grounds.
The visualization shows you in advance the architectural design, the building’s proportions, materials, colors, lighting, and how the property looks in its surroundings.
Depending on the project scope, we prepare working drawings, diagrams, specifications, and other documentation used to implement the project.
Project support. DUMSKAYA DESIGN can support implementation at various stages and work with contractors, manufacturers, and other specialists on the project.
Where needed, we adapt the solutions to technical requirements, the specifics of the property, and local building codes.
We can develop a new architectural concept or adapt an existing design to your site, building, layout, and requirements.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN — architectural design, facade design, interior architecture, and 3D visualization for private and commercial properties.
